editorial.reply: Mostly straightforward retakes. I kept the last full take every time, and none of the earlier attempts had anything the kept one was missing. The two slow spots were the intro "if you've been there" (four tries) and the slide three setup (five tries). The dead air around both is cut down hard, including the 12.7s gap before "uh-oh". I left that one a full second so the beat still works. I kept "when you don't know the answer, and when you don't know the answer" because it reads as deliberate. One thing to check is that the kept take says COO, but later you say "the CEO goes, brilliant, you're promoted". That's either a slip or two different people. Also, "you're being considerate" at the start might have meant "conscientious".
